notThis.name: VoidAI Bridged wTAO

rewardModel.summary: StonkFun reward coins pay holders pro-rata in whatever token the coin is paired against. Paired against TAO, the dividend arrives as TAO.
rewardModel.v3: v3 launches: a transfer tax on every transfer, 1% or 3%, fixed permanently at launch.
rewardModel.legacy: Earlier launches: roughly 85% of the 4% pool trading fee.
rewardModel.payout: Fees accumulate until the pot is worth distributing, then split across holders. There is no fixed schedule.
